title: Logomania
description: A satirical action film examining the over-marketed, corporate world we live in.
altHero: a city where every building features a corporate brand, a cute but huge monster crashes through the city
alt1: elf in a car next to a giant slurpee
alt2: blonde Stacy in a car giggling as the Burly paper towel guy flexes in the car next to her
alt3: monster holding Stacy in its hand climbs a giant Buzz Cola can
alt4: Stacy and the elf flying through the air with more branded buildings behind them
